title: Janis1895
description: A lightweight Vanilla+ modpack for Minecraft 1.21.10 that combines performance, comfort, and style - optimized for smooth gameplay while keeping the classic Minecraft experience intact.
body:
Janis1895 Minecraft Vanilla Modpack (1.21.10)
This modpack enhances Minecraft’s core experience without changing its soul. With performance-boosting mods like Sodium and Entity Culling, the game runs smoother and feels more responsive. Xaero’s Minimap and World Map improve navigation, while Shulker Box Tooltip, Enchantment Descriptions, Zoomify, and Gamma Utils add clarity and ease of use. Features like Open Parties and Claims, Here ’n’ There, and Locator Heads make it perfect for both solo play and multiplayer adventures. All necessary libraries and APIs, including Fabric API, Cloth Config, Forge Config API Port, and YACL, are pre-included for a hassle-free setup. Designed for players who love the authentic Vanilla atmosphere but want better performance and convenience, this pack is ideal for survival worlds, servers, and casual exploration alike.
